responsibility_alignment.rule: E2 supplies sealed inputs, policy approval and official evidence; E1 remains responsible for consuming frozen inputs and publishing one fail-closed terminal state.

findings.observed: The runner mock published success and COMPLETED, but the ten produced artifacts triggered 11 validator failures.
findings.impact: A nominally successful run is not scientifically scoreable.
findings.close_condition: Generate all required valid scientific artifacts and complete validation before final success publication.

findings.observed: Materialized frozen data was archived but not consumed by the mock or production worker path.
findings.impact: B0/S0 comparisons cannot prove they used identical frozen input bytes.
findings.close_condition: Mount frozen inputs read-only into the worker and record byte-level consumption evidence for both modes.

findings.observed: Inherited P03 evidence handling retained a plaintext secret in an attempt outcome artifact.
findings.impact: Archived evidence can leak credentials or fixture secrets.
findings.close_condition: Close the upstream redaction defect and recursively scan every archived evidence file without exclusions.

findings.observed: Deadline enforcement, contract identity propagation, and timeout-versus-cancel classification remain inconsistent upstream.
findings.impact: Integration status and retry decisions can be incorrect or unauditable.
findings.close_condition: Close the upstream defects and rerun classification tests through the real supervisor CLI.

findings.observed: Upstream READY markers, production Skill/Git identity, root lock and image acceptance, official rubric, and G5 joint sign-off are absent.
findings.impact: The candidate cannot enter a formal integration run.
findings.close_condition: Bind every approval to the same candidate, contract, image, Skill, model, task, and rubric hashes.

findings.observed: Approved official-online and native Codex smoke runs are unavailable.
findings.impact: Protocol fixtures do not certify the production host or approved network path.
findings.close_condition: Run the same frozen fixture on the approved network and native Codex host and archive the evidence.

findings.observed: The unified entry point exited 74 while raw result and COMPLETED reported success/0, score was null, the hard gate failed, and the archive retained success/0.
findings.impact: Consumers can reach opposite conclusions about the same run.
findings.close_condition: Create one final result and atomically bind process exit, result, archive, score, manifest, and marker.

findings.observed: Every data-layer error was mapped to download-invalid code 12; an HTTP 403 permission failure could not produce required code 11.
findings.impact: Public error semantics and retry behavior are incorrect.
findings.close_condition: Use one exhaustive versioned mapping for permission, download, format, and unknown internal errors.

findings.observed: The composition audit reported no duplicate worker implementation even when an additional worker file was introduced.
findings.impact: Divergent execution implementations can escape structural review.
findings.close_condition: Audit implementations through AST/dependency structure or an equivalent allowlisted graph and retain a duplicate-worker negative test.

findings.observed: The clean-environment test only used an empty HOME, limited environment, and root working directory; it did not provide namespace, cgroup, read-only filesystem, or network isolation.
findings.impact: The test cannot certify formal sandbox boundaries or write-escape prevention.
findings.close_condition: Keep status PARTIAL until the approved runtime passes isolation and write-escape negative tests.

limitations: No approved official-online execution was performed.
No native Codex host certification was performed.
These observations are external integration evidence, not Benchmark v6 task results.
